collection.title: Ford Mondeo Hatchback 1993 to 1995 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Mondeo Hatchback 1993 to 1995 model requires a 21" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
